claims.claim: Sewing machine tables with treadle stands
claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, 2, and 3 show two sewing machine tables on black cast iron treadle stands.
No weaving machine or loom parts appear in any photo.
No brand, model, or origin marking is visible; identity read_from is empty.
Photo 3 shows only a partial green motor; no video or operation is shown.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: No accessories or manual appear in any photo.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be determined from photos.
Photos do not show the seller's location.

risks.risk: Whether a sewing machine head is included with either table
risks.proof: A photo showing a machine head placed in the rectangular recess or beside the table.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as table only, with no machine head.

risks.risk: Working condition of the treadle mechanisms and foot pedals
risks.proof: A video clip of the treadle being operated smoothly through a full cycle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as treadle condition unknown or not working.

risks.risk: Condition of the table tops beyond visible wear such as scratches, water damage, or veneer lifting
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the entire surface and edges of both tops, including the underside.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tops with hidden damage or wear.

risks.risk: Whether the green motor seen at the edge of photo 3 is included and functional
risks.proof: A photo of the full motor and a video clip of it running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without the motor or as a non-functional motor.

risks.proof: A photo of a manufacturer's plate, serial number, or branding mark.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as vintage of unknown age.

risks.risk: Stability or wobbliness of the stands
risks.proof: A video showing the stands from all angles and a pressure test for wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unstable or wobbly stands.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the full surface and edges of both table tops.
Video of the treadle mechanisms and foot pedals in operation.
Photo of any sewing machine head, accessories, and original manual.
Photo of the full green motor and a clip of it running.
Photo of any brand plate, serial number, or marking to confirm make and age.
response.reason: The witness identifies two sewing machine tables on treadle stands, so a worst-case price is possible; seller claims about origin, motor, accessories, and service history remain unproven and are listed as risks.
